sections.shortTitle: West Pakistan Municipal Committees Exemption From Tax On Buildings And Lands Rules 1962
sections.description:
West Pakistan Municipal Committees (Exemption From Tax On Buildings And
Lands) Rules 1962
West Pakistan Municipal Committees (Exemption From Tax On Buildings And Lands) Rules 1962
[Gazette of West
Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 15th February 1962]
No. SOI (LB) LMC-2 (62)/61. In exercise of the powers conferred by
section 41 read with Section 121 of the-Municipal Administration Ordinance,
1960 (Ordinance X of 1960); the Governor of West Pakistan is pleased to make
the following rules, namely :
1. Short
title and commencement. (1) These rules may be called the West
Pakistan Municipal Committees (Exemption From Tax on
Buildings and Lands) Rules, 1962.
(2) They shall come into force at
once.
2. Property
not to be taxed. No tax on buildings and lands shall be levied in respect of the
following properties :
(a) mosques,
temples, churches, Dharmsalas, Gurdwaras
and other religious buildings ;
(b) public
burial or burning grounds and other places for the disposal of the dead ;
(c) schools,
hostels, dispensaries, orphanages, alm-houses and
drinking water fountains ;
(d) houses of an annual rental
value of not more than such amount' as may be fixed by the Municipal Committee
with the approval of the Controlling Authority, provided that the house is
occupied by the owner and the owner possesses no other house in the
municipality ; and
(e) such
other property as may be specified by Government in this behalf from time to
time.
3. Exemptions
on account of property. If in the opinion of, the Municipal Committee any person liable
to pay tax on buildings and lands in respect of any property is unable to pay
such tax on account of poverty, the Municipal Committee may exempt the property
concerned from the payment of the tax for, a period not exceeding one year, and
may with the sanction of the Controlling Authority renew from time to time such
exemp tion for a period not exceeding one year at a time.
